name: Enterprise Governance (SSO, Policies, BYOS Controls, Audit Exports)
description: Enterprise-grade controls: SAML/OIDC SSO, optional SCIM provisioning, policy enforcement (downloads, sharing, watermarking), BYOS governance requirements, audit logs and exports, and data residency constraints.
goals: Support enterprise tenants with strict access and compliance needs.
Centralize policy enforcement at API layer.
Provide auditable controls and exportable audit trails.
Support BYOS with security guardrails and validation.
nonGoals: Full GRC suite (integrate with external tooling where required).

rules: Enterprise controls are workspace-scoped and may only be set by authorized roles.
Policy evaluation must always include workspace_id and actor context.
Audit logs must be workspace-scoped, immutable, and exportable.

actors.name: Platform Admin
actors.description: Assists with enterprise setup and escalations.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Evaluates policies, enforces governance, exports audits.

workflows.name: Policy Enforcement
steps: Workspace admin sets policies (downloads, sharing, watermark, BYOS constraints).
API middleware loads policy set for workspace and caches it.
Each sensitive endpoint evaluates policy + RBAC + share link policy.
Denied actions return stable error codes and are logged to audit.

workflows.name: Audit Export
steps: Admin requests export for a date range.
Background job queries audit logs and writes export artifact to managed storage.
Generate signed download URL and notify admin when ready.
Exports are retained per policy and are access-controlled.

controls: BYOS validation: allowlist buckets/regions, verify ownership, least-privilege IAM policies.
Immutable audit logs with tamper-evident storage options.
Policy changes require elevated role and are audited.

acceptanceTests: A download-disallowed policy blocks all download endpoints for share-link viewers and staff without override.
Audit export produces a signed URL and is only accessible to authorized admins.
BYOS configuration rejects unsafe IAM policies and disallowed regions.
